# testing_root_union_write_only (Data Source)

RootUnionWriteOnly DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "testing_root_union_write_only" "my_rootunionwriteonly" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `alpha` (Attributes) First root-union variant with a nested writeOnly property (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alpha))
- `beta` (Attributes) Second root-union variant nesting writeOnly properties inside an array of objects, verifying the prior collection is sourced from the variant captured before reallocation rather than the freshly reset variant (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--beta))
- `id` (String) Resource identifier
- `name` (String) Resource name

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Resource identifier
- `name` (String) Resource name

<a id="nestedatt--alpha--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alpha.credentials`

Read-Only:

- `client_id` (String) Readable client identifier
